Rot Coven are a two-piece industrialized noise/sludge/death monstrosity from Southeastern Pennsylvania. Rot Coven formed during 2020, but this prolific duo have been making music together in various bands for about 20 years. Depicting the harsh ugly reality of life. Rhythmic layers and percussive onslaught interrupt a death industrial noise barrage, then any track might err into the dissonance and distorted guitar lines of heavy doom or death metal territory. This really is broken music

Led by Glen Wreckless (guitar/vocals), Chad Goy (drums), and Curtis Gulka (bass), they’ve released four albums to date, with the latest, Here At The End of All Things, dropping in 2024. Relentless and unfiltered, The Vermiculites keep the riffs coming and the volume high.
